bugs.title: Newton-Raphson Reciprocal Scaling Constant 2x Error ((32'd4<<15) vs (32'd2<<15))
bugs.root_cause: In function compute_recip_q30, mr0_q30 is Q2.30 so (mr0_q30 >> 16) is Q1.15 (where 1.0 = 32768 and 2.0 = 65536 = 32'd2 << 15). Line 153 uses (32'd4 << 15) = 131072 (representing 4.0 in Q1.15), computing r1 = r0 * (4.0 - m*r0) instead of r0 * (2.0 - m*r0).
bugs.adversarial_reproduction: With 2 tokens of equal score (s_t=0, v_t=256), denom_q15 = 65536 (2.0). Exact reciprocal is 0.5 (attn_out = 256), but BUG-HC1-001 produces r1 = 1.46875 (+193.8% inflation, attn_out = 752; or 240 under Q16 saturation).

bugs.title: Unreachable rsqrt_seed_lut_q14 Bins 4'b0_000..4'b0_011 Due to Redundant Bit-13 Indexing
bugs.root_cause: leading_Shift_even normalizes m_q14 into [0.5, 2.0) = [8192, 32767]. Whenever m_q14[14] == 0 (m in [0.5, 1.0)), m_q14 >= 8192 guarantees m_q14[13] == 1. Passing m_q14[13:11] to rsqrt_seed_lut_q14 makes LUT entries 4'b0_000..4'b0_011 (lines 79-82) 100% unreachable dead code and maps m in [0.5, 0.75) to wrong seeds.
bugs.adversarial_reproduction: Driven uniform x=185 (m_q14=8556, m=0.522); LUT index {m_q14[14], m_q14[13:11]} = 4'b0_100 selects seed 18448 (1.126) instead of 22486 (1.372), leaving a significant Newton-Raphson residual error.
bugs.stage10_fix: At rtl/taalas_rmsnorm_engine.sv:169, pass (m_q14[14] ? m_q14[13:11] : m_q14[12:10]) as the 3-bit sub-index to rsqrt_seed_lut_q14.

bugs.title: Sub-Word Byte-Strobe RMW Silently Re-Encodes Valid ECC Over Double-Bit Errors & Suppresses ECC Telemetry
bugs.root_cause: During partial-byte RMW (req_we_i && req_wmask_i != 8'hFF), rmw_dec_comb reads raw_word_from_mem (bypassing raw_word_post_inj), ignores rmw_ded_flag_comb, writes back freshly encoded valid Hamming parity over corrupted data, and gates sec_err_o/ded_err_o/sec_err_cnt_o/ded_err_cnt_o with !req_we_i.
bugs.adversarial_reproduction: Injected 2-bit error during req_we_i=1, req_wmask_i=8'h01; ded_err_o and ded_err_cnt_o remained 0 and subsequent read returned corrupted word with clean syndrome 0x00.
bugs.stage10_fix: Feed raw_word_post_inj into rmw_dec_comb, abort RMW writeback (or poison parity) on rmw_ded_flag_comb, and accumulate rmw_sec_flag_comb/rmw_ded_flag_comb into ECC outputs and counters.

bugs.title: KV-Head Dimension Omitted from Internal Q4 Memory Index & Sink-Pointer Wrap at LAST_SEQ_PTR
bugs.root_cause: k_q4_mem/v_q4_mem are sized MAX_USERS*MAX_SEQ_LEN (64) instead of MAX_USERS*NUM_KV_HEADS*MAX_SEQ_LEN (512) and indexed by {act_slot_q, wr_ptr} without act_head_q, causing all 8 GQA KV heads to overwrite each other. Also line 198 (sink_ptr < LAST_SEQ_PTR) wraps sink_tokens_cfg_i == 15 to 0.
bugs.adversarial_reproduction: Appending to kv_head_id=0 and kv_head_id=1 at slot 0 overwrote the same row and incremented the shared write pointer; sink_tokens_cfg_i=15 wrapped wr_ptr to 0.
bugs.stage10_fix: Include act_head_q in k_q4_mem/v_q4_mem/scale/zp/ptr arrays and change (sink_ptr < LAST_SEQ_PTR) to (sink_ptr <= LAST_SEQ_PTR).

bugs.title: OCP MXFP4 Shared Exponent E8M0=0xFF (NaN) Evaluated as Finite Exponent +128
bugs.root_cause: Per OCP Microscaling Formats (MX) v1.0, E8M0 = 8'hFF (255) is reserved exclusively for NaN scale. Line 184 treats 8'hFF as normal unbiased exponent +128, returning +0.0f when dot_int==0 or finite FP32 when dot_int!=0 instead of IEEE-754 qNaN (32'h7FC0_0000).
bugs.adversarial_reproduction: Driven act_e8m0_i=2, w_e8m0_i=8'hFF, code=2 (+1.0); observed fp32_l0_o = 32'h4300_0000 (+128.0f) in both C++ UVM and SV UVM-2020.3.1 (25 scoreboard hits) instead of 32'h7FC0_0000.
bugs.stage10_fix: Detect (act_e8m0_s1[l] == 8'hFF || w_e8m0_s1[l] == 8'hFF) in build_fp32_from_int_and_e8m0 and output 32'h7FC0_0000.

bugs.title: Global active_skew_q Register Overwrites In-Flight Skew Tap & Lacks Downstream Stall Gating
bugs.root_cause: skew_delta_q[0:7] is an 8-stage shift register, but active_skew_q is a single scalar FF updated immediately on valid_s1_q, switching the output tap for earlier in-flight transactions; also skew_valid_q shifts unconditionally on every clock without stall gating when the parallel Via-Mask ROM is in BIST/sleep.
bugs.adversarial_reproduction: Issued back-to-back LoRA transactions with skew_delay_i=4 followed by skew_delay_i=1; second transaction overwrote active_skew_q and dropped the in-flight delta at tap 4.
bugs.stage10_fix: Propagate per-stage target skew metadata alongside skew_delta_q or gate skew updates while in-flight transactions are pending, and add downstream stall_i gating.

bugs.title: Phantom Upstream Credit Return on Local/C2C Flit Pop & Zero-CRC8 False-Negative Waiver
bugs.root_cause: Multiplexing local_tx_valid_i, c2c_rx_valid_i, and in_valid_i into one FIFO without a source tag causes upstream_credit_ret_o <= fifo_pop_en (line 284) to emit phantom upstream credits when local/C2C flits pop; and line 296 ((head_rx_crc8 != 8'd0) && ...) waives CRC checking whenever rx_crc8 == 8'h00.
bugs.adversarial_reproduction: Injected local TX flit (in_valid_i=0, local_tx_valid_i=1) and corrupted flit with rx_crc8=8'h00; observed upstream_credit_ret_o=1 (phantom credit) and crc_err_o=0 (false negative).
bugs.stage10_fix: Store a 2-bit source-port tag in FIFO so upstream_credit_ret_o asserts only for ring-in flits, and remove (head_rx_crc8 != 8'd0) from line 296.

bugs.title: Unclamped 24-to-16-Bit FFN Residual Modulo Wrap, Comb Latch in Layer Tile & Token Embed 1-Cycle Skid Hazard
bugs.root_cause: taalas_hc1_layer_tile.sv:649 slices swiglu_down_acc[i*24+:16] without clamping signed 24b to INT16 (wrapping modulo 65536), and line 369 infers combinational latches on mx_dot/deq_raw_acc_in when !hc2_mxfp4_mode_i; taalas_hc1_chip_top.sv:184 ignores 1-cycle embed_rom_valid latency in tok_in_ready and leaves final_in_vec_q (line 363) unused.
bugs.adversarial_reproduction: FFN down-projection accumulator > 32767 wrapped negative in residual_2_vec; back-to-back token injection overwrote embed_tok_id_q before embed_rom_valid.
bugs.stage10_fix: Saturate swiglu_down_acc[i*24+:24] to [-32768,+32767] and initialize mx_dot/deq_raw_acc_in in taalas_hc1_layer_tile.sv; gate tok_in_ready with !embed_rom_pending and wire final_in_vec_q in taalas_hc1_chip_top.sv.
